_comment: Phase 7 eval harness: a small LABELED retrieval set (query -> relevant chunk_ids). Hand-authored, not derived from any real corpus. Used by evals/retrieval_eval.py together with DETERMINISTIC SYNTHETIC embeddings (see synthetic_dense_embed/synthetic_sparse_embed) to exercise the real hybrid_search/RRF fusion code path against Qdrant's :memory: engine without a GPU. Recall/MRR numbers computed from this fixture are NOT a measurement of real BGE-M3/BM25 retrieval quality -- see README.md's Evaluation section.
